 Kenneth Walker III (groin) misses practice Friday 
 by Ari Koslow | Chiefs Correspondent | Fri, Nov 13th 2026, 2:18pm EST 
 Kenneth Walker III did not practice on Friday. ( Sean McDowell on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Walker came in Friday morning and had "tight groin." "We'll see how he feels through this afternoon, with rehab, and through tomorrow," Reid said. Emmett Johnson should be stashed in all leagues. 
 Kenneth Walker came in this morning and had "tight groin," per Andy Reid, so he sat out practice today.
Reid: "We'll see how he feels through this afternoon, with rehab, and through tomorrow."
— Sam McDowell (@SamMcDowell11) November 13, 2026
